breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained and even reinforced the contradictory half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack instruction. For the nscf step, it explicitly specifies 'a half shift (i.e., shift = 1 1 1 in QE notation) as required by the automatic Monkhorst-Pack with half-shift specification,' directly repeating the error from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth resolves this by removing the half-shift requirement entirely, leaving only the gamma-centered k-point grid instruction. The agent failed to identify and correct this conflict.
